name: Alastor humain — flashback saison 2
prompt: Use case: identity-preserving single static character sprite for Infernal Versus. Draw the HUMAN incarnation of ALASTOR from the official Hazbin Hotel Season 2 flashback, as shown in the three supplied Prime Video reference frames. Image 1 (2 seconds) governs his complete slender body, dark fitted trousers, low black pointed shoes, waistcoat silhouette and daylight palette. Image 2 (4 seconds) governs his warm brown skin, swept dark brown-black curls with reddish highlights, narrow oval spectacles, freckles, angular smiling face and long red necktie. Image 3 (20 seconds) governs the ivory shirt sleeves, dark sleeve garters, burgundy waistcoat and its long pointed lower contour. Keep exactly this human costume and anatomy. One complete full-body character, in a calm upright standing pose, three-quarter side view facing screen-right, one relaxed open hand, the other by his side. Reproduce the show's crisp expressive black 2D animation outlines and flat cel colors. Match his tall narrow human proportions; no deer antlers, no demon ears, no tail, no supernatural transformation. Show the whole hairstyle, fingers and both shoes inside the canvas with at least 7 percent transparent padding on every side. True transparent RGBA background. No floor, scene, cast shadow, words, logos, frame, glass, microphone, weapon, other character, second pose, multi-panel sheet or animation. This is a single clothed human character portrait intended as a static archive/costume sprite.

findings: Visage brun humain, chevelure bouclée, lunettes, cravate rouge, gilet bordeaux et garrots de manche conformes aux trois vues officielles inspectées.
Une silhouette entière isolée ; pieds, cheveux et doigts visibles. Les marges haut/bas sont plus petites que le prompt, sans coupe observée.
Comparaison sur fonds blanc et gris : vraie transparence, aucun halo de fond visible ; alpha intérieur maximal 254, limitation conservée.
limits: Les références natives ne font que 320×180 : détails fins non certifiés.
La pose debout est une adaptation de jeu ; aucun cycle ni kit de combat créé.
Proportions/expressivité dessinées approximatives ; certification 1:1 non revendiquée.
